1.sahih_international: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
1.pickthall: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
1.yusuf_ali: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
1.shakir: Surely We have given you Kausar,
1.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have granted you abundant virtue.
1.mohsin_khan: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise);
1.arberry: Surely We have given thee abundance;

2.sahih_international: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
2.pickthall: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
2.yusuf_ali: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
2.shakir: Therefore pray to your Lord and make a sacrifice.
2.muhammad_sarwar: So worship your Lord and make sacrificial offerings.
2.mohsin_khan: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).
2.arberry: so pray unto thy Lord and sacrifice.

3.sahih_international: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
3.pickthall: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
3.yusuf_ali: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
3.shakir: Surely your enemy is the one who shall be without posterity,
3.muhammad_sarwar: Whoever hates you will himself remain childless.
3.mohsin_khan: For he who makes you angry (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)), - he will be cut off (from every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).
3.arberry: Surely he that hates thee, he is the one cut off.
